verdict.rationale: Weave documents a REST Service API and the docs site exposes a working openapi.json, suggesting a machine-readable API spec that could power an interactive reference, but there is no evidence of an actual interactive explorer or runnable code examples (e.g., a Swagger/try-it UI) beyond the raw spec file. missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive API reference UI, evidence of runnable/executable examples, and any independent corroboration of hands-on use.
